title: Choose the visual world (techy, warm, clean, light)
question: Re-dealt for techy but light, warm and personal, clean and professional. The roll assigned the Assembly Manual.

options.label: Assembly Manual
options.thesis: Hiring Kushwant as a kit you assemble: a parts list, numbered steps, exploded diagrams of each project, all on clean white paper with one signal-orange callout colour.
options.viewport: A step 1 circle and huge headline, an 'In this kit' parts table (role, projects shipped, freelance slot, reply time), and an exploded line drawing whose lettered callouts link to projects.
options.risk: Can read as gimmicky if every section performs the joke. It holds with real diagrams in the hero and Projects, and quiet numbered pages everywhere else.

raised.raise: Every project caption names each part of its stack precisely, ruled beneath the figure like a garment label.
One event, many tracks: every section's callouts trace back to the hero kit, so the page reads as one assembly.

options.label: Engineering Drawing
options.lineage: drafting sheets with title blocks and zone grids
options.thesis: Each section is one drawing sheet: a zone-marked border, a title block with sheet number and revision, and handwritten blue-pencil notes for warmth.
options.viewport: A framed sheet with zone letters, the headline in the drawing area, a handwritten margin note, and a title block bottom-right holding name, sheet 01/08, revision and availability.
options.risk: Familiar: blueprint and drafting looks are where many developer portfolios already land.

options.label: Boarding pass and gate board
options.lineage: airline boarding passes and gate displays
options.thesis: Experience and projects as a gate board of rows; the hero a boarding pass with a scannable block for contact.
options.viewport: A boarding pass hero, name as passenger and Hyderabad as origin, with the board below.
options.case: Techy, light and clean. It loses on warmth, since travel ephemera reads impersonal.
options.risk: Travel props can feel unrelated to software work.

options.label: Industrial quote grammar
options.thesis: Plain words in straight quotes ('PROJECT', 'CLIENT'), zip-tie orange tags, hazard diagonals as section dividers on white.
options.viewport: A white sheet with the headline in quotes and an orange tag hanging off the role line.
options.case: Clean, light and bold. It loses on warmth and personal feel.
options.risk: Reads as fashion pastiche to recruiters.

options.label: Suminagashi ink
options.thesis: Paper-white page with one indigo ink field you drag in the hero; quiet everywhere else.
options.viewport: Headline left, and a live ink basin right that swirls under the pointer.
options.case: Light, warm and subtle. It loses on techy.
options.risk: Reads like the marbled sheets you already passed on.

options.label: Collider event display
options.kept: Every section traces back to the hero.

options.label: Coiled earth tower
options.risk: Terracotta reads as the AI default.

options.label: Sapeur portrait plate
options.risk: Needs a portrait we don't have.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean white developer portfolio, executed carefully.
canonCard.viewport: Headline left, image block right, blue button.
